import Mathlib

theorem group_identity_unique {G : Type*} [Group G] (e f : G)
    (he : ∀ x : G, e * x = x) (hf : ∀ x : G, x * f = x) : e = f :=
  calc e = e * f := (hf e).symm
    _ = f := he f
